First, a list of key elements from cryIfKeyId and targetCryIfKeyId shall be read using the function Crypto_<vi>_<ai__KeyElementdsIdGet(). All key elements from this list that are identical to each other shall be copied by reading each key element of cryIfKeyId with Crypto_<vi>_<ai>_KeyElementGet() and setting the target key element of targetCryIfKeyId via Crypto_<vi>_<ai>_KeyElementSet().
